title: Kubernetes Pod Restart Hotspot
app: Kubernetes homelab clusters, Proxmox, Vaultwarden, Paperless-ngx, Immich, AdGuard Home, Docker, TrueNAS, and NUT metrics via APIs, logs, Telegraf, and Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=kubernetes:pod
| stats sum(restart_count) as restart_count by namespace pod
| where restart_count>3
| sort - restart_count
description: Uses Kubernetes pod metrics telemetry to monitor which pods are restarting repeatedly in index=personal.
value: Splunk turns the feed into an operational check for services that are unstable inside the homelab cluster, so the signal does not stay buried inside separate consumer apps or exports.
implementation: Ingest Kubernetes pod metrics data through its real API, export, MQTT bridge, or open-source connector into `index=personal`; preserve the fields referenced in the SPL and schedule the search on a hourly cadence.
visualization: Namespace and pod table of restart counts.
grandmaExplanation: It flags which pods are restarting repeatedly so you can spot services that are unstable inside the homelab cluster before it becomes annoying.
